recall_prompt: Say how you would find the multiplicative inverse — what the inverse is, and how you write it as a + ib.
insider_note: The multiplicative inverse is 1/z, not the conjugate — the conjugate is only the multiplier that clears the denominator. The denominator 7² + 24² = 625 comes from the 7, 24, 25 triple, so any other number there is an arithmetic slip.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Write the reciprocal
steps.margin_note: First mark. The multiplicative inverse of z is 1/z. Multiply above and below by the conjugate 7 − 24i so the denominator becomes 7² + 24².
steps.memory_tip: The multiplicative inverse is 1/z. The conjugate is only the multiplier that clears the denominator.

recall.must_convey: That the multiplicative inverse is 1/(7 + 24i), and multiplying top and bottom by 7 − 24i makes the denominator 7² + 24².
accept: the inverse is one over seven plus twenty four i, multiply top and bottom by seven minus twenty four i
write one by z and rationalise with the conjugate seven minus twenty four i
the denominator becomes seven squared plus twenty four squared
inverse ante one by z, conjugate tho multiply cheyali
multiplicative inverse is the reciprocal, rationalise it

steps.why: z times its multiplicative inverse is 1, so the inverse is 1/z. A quotient with a complex denominator is written as a + ib by the conjugate, and (7 + 24i)(7 − 24i) = 49 + 576 has no i.
common_mistakes: Giving the conjugate 7 − 24i itself as the inverse.

steps.label: Simplify
steps.margin_note: Second mark. 49 + 576 = 625. Write the answer with the real and imaginary parts separated.
steps.memory_tip: 49 + 576 = 625, from the 7, 24, 25 triple. Split the answer into a real part and an imaginary part.

recall.must_convey: That the denominator is 625, so the inverse is 7/625 − (24/625)i.
accept: forty nine plus five seventy six is six twenty five so the inverse is seven by six twenty five minus twenty four by six twenty five i
the answer is seven minus twenty four i over six hundred twenty five
seven by six two five minus twenty four i by six two five
denominator six twenty five, inverse seven by six twenty five minus twenty four by six twenty five i
divide seven minus twenty four i by six hundred and twenty five

steps.why: 7² + 24² = 625 = 25² — the same 7, 24, 25 triple appears in the square-root question on the next page. The answer must be split into a real part and an imaginary part to be in the form a + ib.
common_mistakes: Leaving the answer as (7 − 24i)/625 without separating — acceptable to many examiners, but the split form is safer.
